title: Unthanked
summary: UNTHANK'ED, adjective 1. Not thanked; not repaid with acknowledgments. 2. Not received with thankfulness; as an unthanked reprieve. [Unusual.]

inlines.v: UNTHANK'ED, adjective 1. Not thanked; not repaid with acknowledgments. 2. Not received with thankfulness; as an unthanked reprieve. [Unusual.]
